boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Monmouth study environments with current reservation or location guidance from University sources.

cards.title: Study Room 1
cards.subtitle: Guggenheim Memorial Library · first floor
cards.notes: Reserve this 14-seat room for a project meeting; the first-floor setting permits collaborative conversation. Book only the time your group needs.
cards.short_summary: A reservable first-floor room for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Guggenheim Memorial Library lists Study Room 1 on its first floor with 14 seats and permits collaborative conversation there.
cards.source_title: Study Space Reservations | Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Reservable; library says bookings may be made twice in a row and rooms cannot be blocked all day or weeks ahead.

cards.title: Study Room 2A
cards.subtitle: Guggenheim Memorial Library · second floor
cards.notes: Reserve the six-seat Room 2A when your group needs a quieter library floor where brief conversation is allowed. Leave the room ready for the next user.
cards.short_summary: A six-seat reservable room on the library's quieter second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Guggenheim Memorial Library lists Study Room 2A as a six-seat room on the second floor, where quiet and brief conversation are allowed.
cards.source_title: Study Space Reservations | Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Reservable; library says bookings may be made twice in a row and rooms cannot be blocked all day or weeks ahead.

cards.title: Study Room 2B
cards.subtitle: Guggenheim Memorial Library · second floor
cards.notes: Use the six-seat Room 2B for a small working session and keep voices brief and quiet, consistent with the second-floor study guidance.
cards.short_summary: Another six-seat option on the library's second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Guggenheim Memorial Library lists Study Room 2B as a six-seat room on the second floor, where quiet and brief conversation are allowed.
cards.source_title: Study Space Reservations | Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Reservable; library says bookings may be made twice in a row and rooms cannot be blocked all day or weeks ahead.

cards.title: Study Room 3A
cards.subtitle: Guggenheim Memorial Library · third floor
cards.notes: Reserve Room 3A for focused work and follow the third-floor silent-study expectation. Plan any discussion before leaving the room or on another floor.
cards.short_summary: A six-seat reservable room in the library's silent-study area.
cards.evidence_claim: Guggenheim Memorial Library lists Study Room 3A as a six-seat room on its third floor, designated for silent study.
cards.source_title: Study Space Reservations | Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Reservable; library says bookings may be made twice in a row and rooms cannot be blocked all day or weeks ahead.

cards.title: Study Room 3B
cards.subtitle: Guggenheim Memorial Library · third floor
cards.notes: Choose Room 3B for a quiet six-seat setup, then honor the library's silent-study rules so the third floor remains workable for everyone.
cards.short_summary: A six-seat room within the library's silent-study floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Guggenheim Memorial Library lists Study Room 3B as a six-seat room on its third floor, designated for silent study.
cards.source_title: Study Space Reservations | Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Reservable; library says bookings may be made twice in a row and rooms cannot be blocked all day or weeks ahead.

cards.title: AARC Common Space
cards.subtitle: Athletics Academic Resource Center
cards.notes: Reserve an individual seat in the AARC Common Space when a personal workstation fits the task. Bring a covered beverage only; food is not allowed.
cards.short_summary: Reservable individual seating in the Athletics Academic Resource Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Athletics Academic Resource Center reservation page offers individual seats in its AARC Common Space and says covered beverages are permitted but food is not.
cards.source_title: Study Space Reservations – Athletics Academic Resource Center | Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Individual seats are reservable. The page says reservations may be made twice in a row and cannot block space all day or weeks ahead.

cards.title: AARC Room 1
cards.subtitle: Athletics Academic Resource Center · two seats
cards.notes: Reserve this two-seat AARC room for a partner review session or a compact online-work setup. Wipe down the table when you finish.
cards.short_summary: A reservable two-seat AARC room for paired work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Athletics Academic Resource Center reservation page lists AARC Room 1 as an individual room with two seats.
cards.source_title: Study Space Reservations – Athletics Academic Resource Center | Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Reservable; the page instructs users to wipe down tables and says food is not allowed, while covered beverages are permitted.

cards.title: AARC Room 2
cards.subtitle: Athletics Academic Resource Center · two seats
cards.notes: Book this two-seat AARC room for a focused study pair. Keep food outside and reset the table after use for the next reservation.
cards.short_summary: A second reservable two-seat room in the AARC.
cards.evidence_claim: The Athletics Academic Resource Center reservation page lists AARC Room 2 as an individual room with two seats.
cards.source_title: Study Space Reservations – Athletics Academic Resource Center | Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Reservable; the page instructs users to wipe down tables and says food is not allowed, while covered beverages are permitted.

cards.title: AARC Room 3
cards.subtitle: Athletics Academic Resource Center · four seats
cards.notes: Reserve the four-seat AARC Room 3 for a small group that needs one contained workspace. Clean the table afterward and observe the food policy.
cards.short_summary: A reservable four-seat room for small-group academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Athletics Academic Resource Center reservation page lists AARC Room 3 as an individual room with four seats.
cards.source_title: Study Space Reservations – Athletics Academic Resource Center | Guggenheim Memorial Library
cards.access_notes: Reservable; the page instructs users to wipe down tables and says food is not allowed, while covered beverages are permitted.

cards.title: Lounge/Study Space
cards.subtitle: Rebecca Stafford Student Center · second floor
cards.notes: Head to the named second-floor Lounge/Study Space in the Student Center for open study time. For a booked room, use the University's student study-space reservation process.
cards.short_summary: An open named study area in the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth University's Student Center Directory lists a Lounge/Study Space on the second floor of the Rebecca Stafford Student Center.
cards.source_title: Student Center Directory | Student Engagement | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: Listed as Lounge/Study Space. University guidance says study spaces outside the library are first-come, first-served; separately reservable campus rooms are limited to two-hour blocks.
